g.text: no dated tie in the period

8,183 drawable ties dated to this period, among 1,464 firms across 118 places; the grey firms have no dated tie here. 40.8% of those ties touch Paris — 62.4% if only firms with a street address are counted. Coverage: 84.3% of the 1,775 firms active in the
period can be placed at all. Same coordinates as figures 53 to 56.
